content.text: Perfect! **Summary**: I resolved ticket T-4002 by identifying that the pdf-exporter 1.5.0 deployment timeout was caused by PodSecurity policy violations in the documents namespace. The cluster enforces the "restricted" policy, which requires specific security context settings that the new image version lacks. I provided the ticket owner with the exact security context configuration needed to make the deployment compliant and successfully roll out version 1.5.0.
